name: UpperDeck
subtitle: One Piece TCG tournament tracker
description: Install and update UpperDeck with SideStore or AltStore.

apps.name: UpperDeck
apps.subtitle: Every round, on one pass.
apps.localizedDescription: Track your own and your friends' One Piece TCG tournament results. Log every round in a tap, build decks from the full card list, share passes and play group tournaments.
apps.versionDescription:
Development release; online features remain mocked.

Screen and interaction improvements throughout UpperDeck:

- More reliable Player Pass and leader-filter opening, improved button hit areas, and swipe-back navigation.
- Round logging opens edit details directly, with animated winner selection and improved leader picking.
- Consistent scrolling and stretchy image headers; long round histories stay within tournament tiles.
- Deck cards support tap to add, hold to inspect with lift animation and haptics, and swipe left to remove a copy.
- Fixed Add Cards dismissal crashes and made deck-limit messages visible above the keyboard.
- Cleaner card inspection backgrounds with native, resisted scrolling even for short content.
- Head-to-head artwork is centered per side; the animated divider reflects the score and stays within a 90/10 split.
- Tournament sharing now uses Story format with an animated, content-sized pass and stable export controls.
- Dark Story backgrounds, a smooth Transparent Background toggle, readable overlapping text, and both first/second turn labels.
- PNG sharing and saving preserve transparency and rounded corners, including profile pass exports.
